definition.en: A sudden neurological deficit caused by interruption of blood flow to the brain or bleeding within the brain.
definition.ps: دا د طبي زده کړې لنډه تشریح ده: A sudden neurological deficit caused by interruption of blood flow to the brain or bleeding within the brain.
definition.fa: خلاصه آموزشی: A sudden neurological deficit caused by interruption of blood flow to the brain or bleeding within the brain.

explanation.en: Stroke is an emergency. Rapid recognition and treatment are important because brain tissue can be injured quickly.
explanation.ps: د دې اصطلاح مهم معلومات د زده کړې لپاره په ساده ډول وړاندې کېږي.
explanation.fa: اطلاعات اصلی این اصطلاح برای مطالعه به شکل ساده ارائه می‌شود.

source: U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM) MeSH — educational summary
